description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes between, Ceylon Workers Congress and Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the appointment of an arbitrator under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle a specific labor dispute. It references specific legislation (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and contains a legal order made by the Minister of Labour exercising statutory powers. While it mentions a government minister (Nimal Siripala De Silva), the core content is about implementing a legal/regulatory framework for dispute resolution rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) which covers statutory instruments, regulatory actions, and legal proceedings.
